title: Final Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify T_min = ln(2)/4.6 K as the minimum temperature for the process.

title: Clausius-Clapeyron Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly state and apply the Clausius-Clapeyron equation to relate pressure and temperature changes.

title: Entropy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the expressions for liquid and solid entropy correctly, including the contribution from nuclear spins.

title: Graph Quality
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide a semi-quantitative p-T diagram that accurately reflects the behavior of He^3 at low temperatures.

title: Understanding of Phase Behavior
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain how increasing pressure at low temperatures leads to cooling of the solid-liquid mixture.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid incorrect signs in the Clausius-Clapeyron equation or in the interpretation of dp/dT.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations and explanations.
